title: Intrinsic Geometry of the Stock Market from Graph Ricci Flow - Replication Spec
hypothesis: Discrete Ollivier-Ricci graph curvature with Ricci flow on fully connected empirical correlation graph reveals intrinsic geometry; neckpinch singularities develop and surgery along zero-curvature flat links after ~20 iterations detects hidden hierarchies/communities without MST pruning or preset k. Positive initial curvature (all >0, median weight 1.11, avg corr 38%) spherical; flow separates communities with short positive vs long flat (~3) zero curvature links obeying theoretical lower bound -1.96 even with unequal weights.
sample: NASDAQ-100 index components from wiki_nasdaq [wiki_nasdaq] retrieved from Yahoo! Finance [yahoo_fin]. Node = stock, edge = Pearson correlation transformed distance. Fully connected undirected weighted complete graph with N=100 stocks per index name. No additional filters printed. Correlation matrix computed from time series of returns r_i. Edge weight w_ij = sqrt(2(1-C_ij)). Returns averaging window is five-year period. Daily vs log returns not stated. Subsample counts for hierarchical clustering refer to partitions below. Total sample size claim n_total_100.
method: 1. Universe: get NASDAQ-100 constituents list from wiki_nasdaq at unspecified date (not stated, as of retrieval).
2. Data: download stock price time series for each ticker from Yahoo! Finance for period 1/1/2020 to 20/11/2024.

3. Returns: compute returns r_i(t) per stock (frequency not stated: daily assumed; formula not stated: simple vs log). Compute mean bar{r_i} and std sigma_i over the 5-year window (no rolling window described).
4. Correlation: compute empirical Pearson C_ij = <(r_i - bar{r_i})(r_j - bar{r_j})> / (sigma_i sigma_j).

5. Distance/weight: define edge weight w_ij = sqrt(2*(1-C_ij)) for all i!=j. This is initial fully connected graph G(V,E,w) with w_ij>0. Initial shortest path distance d(i,j) induced by w (for complete graph = direct w_ij).

6. Coarse curvature: for each edge ij compute Ollivier-Ricci curvature kappa_ij = 1 - W(m_i,m_j)/d(i,j). Probability measure m_x^alpha with alpha=1/2: m_x(x)=alpha=1/2, m_x(y)=(1-alpha)/d_x for y in pi(x) neighbors, else 0. d_x = degree normalization (=n-1 for complete graph). Wasserstein distance W(m_i,m_j) = min_P sum_{u,v} d(u,v)P(u,v) s.t. marginals = m_i,m_j; computed via optimal transport (implementation from [ni2019community][github] referenced). Use alpha=1/2 throughout; drop alpha index.

7. Histograms: plot distributions of w_ij and kappa_ij for initial graph; record theoretical benchmarks: complete equal-weight kappa=0.505, Laplacian eigenvalues 0 and n/(n-1), bounds -2 to 1, lower bound kappa_min formula.

8. Discrete Ricci flow: generate time-dependent family G(V,E,w(t)) with iterative update: w_ij^{(l+1)} = (1 - kappa_ij^{(l)}) * d^{(l)}(i,j) where kappa_ij^{(l)} is current ORC and d^{(l)} is current shortest path distance induced by w^{(l)}. Update all edges simultaneously each iteration. Iterate for l=0 to 20 (report after 5,10,20 iterations). No normalized flow; allow shrinkage to singularity.

9. Visualization: after each iteration, plot histograms of w and kappa and scatter w vs kappa to identify neckpinch/dumbbell. Expect initially all kappa>0 spherical, very narrow distribution around median 1.11; with flow positive edges cluster short, negative hyperbolic would lengthen (not present initially); flat neck develops with kappa->0.

10. Surgery rule (novel): after 20 iterations, identify neckpinch singularity as flat links with curvature ~0 and edge weight around 3 (theoretical lower bound length 2.96 for n=100). Perform surgery by cutting/removing edges with kappa ~=0 separating two communities. This uses lower bound kappa_min ~ -1.96 and theoretical bounds -2 to 1 as reference that graph obeys even with unequal weights.

11. Hierarchical clustering by recursion: apply steps 6-10 recursively to each separated community: Level1 surgery on full 100 -> 66 (tech) +35 (non-cyclicals). Level2 on 66 -> extract 16 semiconductors (list Table) remainder 50. Level2 other branch on 35 -> split into 10 health/staples +8 staples/energy +17 industrials. Level3 on 50 -> extract 10 outliers remainder 40. Level4 on 40 -> extract 4 biotech +1 SMCI remainder 35. Level5 on remainder 35 -> split 17 Big Tech +18 Tesla group. No preset k, no MST pruning, no external assumptions.
12. Outputs: tables of ticker/name/sector/sub-industry for each cluster at levels 2-5 as in Appendix. Analyses of semiconductor absence of NVDA initially etc described in text.

13. Not stated: intraday vs close prices, adjustment for splits/dividends, handling of missing tickers (e.g., added/dropped during 2020-2024), correlation significance filtering, Wasserstein solver details, exact shortest path algorithm for complete graph with updated weights, random seed, code repo commit.
